messages:
raj_acme: Hey team — after last night's rollout our assistant started dropping the system instructions in long conversations. Previously instructions persisted across ~14–16k tokens, now they vanish around 3.5–4k and responses ignore the persona. Example: system: 'You are a terse financial assistant...' then later the assistant answers like a generic chatty bot. Request ID: req_0a7f9c. model: redwood-alpha-2. Can share prompt/trace.
maya_support: Thanks Raj — sorry for the disruption. Can you paste a minimal repro (prompt + request headers) and the request_id? Also which region and account? We'll triage and escalate.
raj_acme: Request ID above, region: us-west-2, account: acme-inc. Minimal repro below (I redacted PII):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk_acme_redacted
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-2",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a terse financial assistant that refuses to give tax/legal advice."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Start conversation... (repeat filler to push tokens to ~12k)"}
  ],
  "max_tokens": 2048,
  "stream": false
}
```
Observed tokens at failure: input ~12000, output truncated and system seemed lost.
maya_support: Got it. Reproducing locally now. Can you confirm whether you switched to any SDK client flags (streaming vs buffered) recently?
raj_acme: No SDK changes, just hit a spike in usage around the time you rolled the new runtime (we got the banner). Latency also spiked briefly but then stabilized.
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: rollout/redwood-runtime/2026-03-15-21:18:13 — canary 25% -> 100% success.
carmen_eng: I see the request_id in our logs, pulling traces. Early notes: there's an eviction event in the KV cache at ~3.7k tokens for that session. Runtime log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T03:22:14Z] req=req_0a7f9c stage=kv_cache evict reason=pressure reserve=0.10 seq_len=3712 model=redwood-alpha-2
[2026-03-16T03:22:14Z] req=req_0a7f9c stage=decode tokens_generated=120 partial_out="..."
```
Looks like new kernel scheduling changed memory accounting for cached prefixes and made the reserve lower under load, so pinned system messages were not sufficiently protected.
maya_support: Carmen — is this change part of the rollout? Any config toggle we can flip for customers while you prepare a patch?
carmen_eng: Yes, an optimization to reduce memory headroom under batching changed the effective min_kv_reserve from 0.20 -> 0.10 for some model variants. That lowers per-session reserved KV memory and can evict long-system prefixes earlier under bursty seq len distributions. Patch candidate: restore min_kv_reserve=0.20 for redwood-alpha-2 and mark system-role messages as non-evictable until output generation completes.
theo_sre: We could also roll a runtime canary rollback for the last deploy window. But that's heavier. Short-term mitigation: recommend customers set a server-side flag we can toggle: "min_kv_reserve_override": "0.20" at account level; we can turn it on for acme-inc now.
maya_support: Raj — we can enable the override for you immediately. It will increase memory usage but should restore expected behavior. Do you want us to apply it to acme-inc now?
raj_acme: Please apply it, thanks. Also can you confirm impact on latency/cost? Our infra budget is tight.
carmen_eng: Enabling reserve=0.20 will slightly reduce burst capacity (more conservative memory per session) — you might see marginally higher queuing under extreme bursts, but per-token latency for active sessions should be unchanged. Cost: negligible at API billing level, it's internal infra consumption. We'll monitor.
maya_support: Applied override for account acme-inc. Please test and report.
raj_acme: Quick sanity check: after override the assistant preserved system instructions across my long test. Behavior restored. Thanks. We'll keep testing through tomorrow.
carmen_eng: Follow-up action items: (1) ship patch to mark system-role messages as pinned (prevent eviction) by default for all GA model variants — target hotfix within 48h, (2) revert the memory aggressor optimization or gate it behind a flag, (3) add e2e regression test that simulates long-prefix preservation under high seq len and batching. I've filed ENG-3812.
maya_support: Noted. I'll keep this thread updated. Assigning to Carmen for the patch and Theo for rollout safety checks.
theo_sre: Adding a monitoring alert for abnormal early-eviction rates (>0.5% of sessions) and a dashboard widget. If we see more customer hits we'll auto-enable min_kv_reserve_override account-wide as emergency mitigation.
raj_acme: Appreciate the quick help. Will report back if we see any regressions.

maya_support: Closing loop: temporary fix applied (min_kv_reserve_override=0.20), root cause identified (kv cache reserve change during rollout), hotfix and tests planned. I'll reopen if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
